logRoute.title: Logging to another server too
logRoute.description: Pick a log server (where you have Manage Server and the bot is present). Then for each log type you can choose a channel on this server or on the log server — the main server stays tidy and the logs are still kept.
logRoute.label: Log server
logRoute.hint: Its channels appear as a separate group in the log channel pickers.
logRoute.active: Log channels can also be picked from {name} (below).
